answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique whale shark photo-ID catalog entry — a spot pattern matched to one animal over five seasons — which makes the orchard of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a spot pattern matched to one animal over five seasons, and the relic grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pulse of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
